paite: Thutut zuau na genzak ding ahi kei. Theihpih diklou hi ding in migiloute toh na kizop ding ahi kei.
heading: Dikna Leh Hoihna

paite: Gilou hih ding in mipi na zui ding ahi kei. Vaihawmna kaikawi ding in mi tam lamlam zui in amau na gum ding ahi kei.
Thubuai genna ah mizawng dou in guptuam na nei ding ahi kei.
Na melma bawngtal hiam sabiltung hiam taimang na tuahleh, akiang a na pi nawn ngeingei ding ahi.
Nang hon homi' sabiltung, avan puak lel a puk na muhleh taisan lou a, na panpih ngeingei ding ahi.
Thubuai a kihekna ah mizawngte a ding in thukhenna na kaikawi ding ahi kei.
Thil diklou a pan gamlapi ah om in, thil hihkhial lou leh midikte that ke'n; migiloute siamtangsak lou ding ka hih ziak in.
Golhgukna na la ding ahi kei. Golhgukna in mit atosak a, midiktatte thu akaikawi ngal hi.
Huai lou in mikhual na hihgenthei ding ahi kei. Mikhual lungtang na theih ziak in, Aigupta gam ah mikhual in na om ngeita uh, chih thei in.
Kum guk sung na gam ah haichi na tuh dia, agahte na lakhawm ding,
heading: Akum Sagihna Leh Ani Sagihna

paite: himahleh akum sagihna na omsak kinken a, na khawlsak ding ahi; na mite lak a mizawngte'n anektheihna ding un. Anutsiat peuh uh gamlak sate'n ane ding uhi. Huchibang mah in na grephuan leh na olive huan tung ah na hih ding uhi.
Ni guk sung nangmah nna na sem dia, ani sagih ni in na khawl ding; na bawngtal leh na sabiltung akhawl ua, na sikhanu tapa leh mikhual ahalhtheihna ding un.
Na kiang a ka gen tengteng zui ding in pilvang inla; pathian dangte min lou ke'n, na kam a pan zak in leng om kei hen.
Kum khat sung in ka kiang ah ankuangluina thumvei na bawl ding ahi.
heading: Ankuangluina Thupi Thumte / (Eks 34.18-26; Diu 16.1-17)

paite: Tanghou Silngou Soh Louh Ankuangluina bawl in ka hon thupiak bang in, Abib kha a hun sehsa in, ni sagih sung tanghou silngou soh louh na ne ding ahi, huai ni a Aigupta a pan hong paikhia na hih ziak in. Ka ma a kuamah khutvuak a ahong kilat ding uh ahi kei.
Pawltak Ankuanglui, na sepgim gahte, lou a na tuh Puaklutna Ankuangluina na bawl ding ahi. Na lou a pan na sepgimna gahte na puaklut khit chiang in kum tawp ah, Puaklut Ankuanglui na bawl ding ahi.
Kum khat sung in thumvei pasal tengteng Toupa PATHIAN ma a akilat ding uh ahi.
Ka kithoihna sisan, tanghou silngou soh toh na lat ding ahi kei. Ka kithoihna thau a zingsang chiang tan in a-om ding leng ahi kei hi,
TOUPA na Pathian inn a na gam gah masa hoihpente lak a masapen na laklut ding ahi. Kelnou, api nawitui in na huan ding ahi kei.
Ngai in, lampi a nang hon kem ding leh ka mun bawlsa a nang hon tun ding in na ma ah Angel khat ka sawl hi.
heading: Thuchiamte Leh Thuhilhte

paite: Ama ah pilvang inla, a-aw zui in hehsak ke'n; na tatleknate angaihdam louh ding ziak in, ka min lah amah ah a-om ngal a.
Himahleh a-aw na zuih taktak a, ka gen tengteng na hihleh; na melmate tung ah melma ka hi dia, nang hon doute tung ah doumi ka hi ding hi.
Na ma ah ka Angel pai ding ahi, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Kanaante, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah nang ahon pilut ding hi; huchi in amaute ka satkhe ding hi.

Apathiante uh ma ah na kun ding ahi kei. A-nna uh leng na sem ding ahi sam kei. Athilhihte bang uh leng na hih ding uh ahi kei. Himahleh amaute na zou siang sipsip dia, amilimte uh na hihzan dimdem ding ahi.
TOUPA na Pathian uh nna na sem ding ua, ama'n na annek-tuidawn uh avualzawl ding hi. Huchi in na lak ua pan chinatna ka lamang ding hi.
Kuamah nausia a-om kei dia, na gamsung uah kuamah aching kei ding. Na nite zah uh ka tangtungsak ding hi.
Na ma uah kei lauhna ka sawl dia, na hong tunna mi tengteng lak ah buaizakna ka omsak ding hi. Huchi in na melma tengteng nang a pan ka taikeksak ding hi.
Na ma ah khuaizanta ka sawl dia, huai in Hivte, Kanaante leh Hitte na ma a pan ahawlkhe ding hi.
Kum khat sung in amaute na ma a pan ka hawlkhe kei ding. Agam ahong vuak dia, noute hon hihse ding in gamsa ahong pung kha ding hi.
Na hong pun ua, gam na luah mateng, na ma ua pan amaute tawm khakha in ka hawlkhe ding hi.
Tuipi San a pan Philistiate tuipi pha hial in, gamdai a pan Lui chiang pha in na gamgi ka khung ding. Na khut ua agam luah mite ka hon piakkhiak ding ziak in na ma uah amaute na hawlkhe ding uhi.
Amaute toh hiam apathiante uh toh hiam leng thukhun na bawl ding uh ahi kei.
Na gamsung uah ateng ding uh ahi kei. Ka tung ah nang ahon khialsak kha ding uhi. Apathiante uh nna na sep uleh huaite nou a ding in thang ahi ding hi.
